fields.label: Default SAR Type - Sales
fields.description: Default Stock Release Number type for Sales transactions. 11=Sales, 02=Purchase, 03=Sales Return, 04=Stock Transfer In, 06=Material Receipt, 12=Purchase Return, 13=Inter-Branch Transfer Out

fields.label: Default SAR Type - Purchase
fields.description: Default Stock Release Number type for Purchase transactions

fields.label: Default SAR Type - Stock Entry
fields.description: Default Stock Release Number type for Stock Entry transactions

fields.label: Enable Auto Sync
fields.description: Automatically sync Stock Release Numbers to KRA on submit

fields.label: Enable RBAC
fields.description: Enable Role-Based Access Control for eTIMS operations (recommended for production)

fields.label: Enforce Branch Isolation
fields.description: Users can only access documents from their assigned branch (Admin/Manager exempt)

fields.label: Allow Cross-Branch Operations
fields.description: Allow Managers to perform operations across all branches

fields.label: API Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Request timeout in seconds (default: 30, max: 300)

fields.label: Production API URL
fields.description: KRA eTIMS Production API endpoint

fields.label: Sandbox API URL
fields.description: KRA eTIMS Sandbox API endpoint

fields.label: Enable Retry Logic
fields.description: Automatically retry failed API requests

fields.label: Max Retry Attempts
fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests (default: 3)

fields.label: Retry Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Delay between retry attempts in seconds (default: 2)

fields.label: Default Search Limit
fields.description: Default number of results to return from search endpoints (default: 100)

fields.label: Max Search Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of results allowed from search endpoints (default: 1000)

fields.label: Enable Error Logging
fields.description: Log API errors to Error Logging doctype

fields.label: Enable Permission Logging
fields.description: Log all permission checks for audit trail

fields.label: Error Notification Email
fields.description: Send error notifications to this email address (optional)

fields.label: Enforce Invoice Verification
fields.description: Require all supplier invoices to be verified with KRA before payment. Critical for 2026 tax compliance.

fields.label: Auto-Verify Invoices
fields.description: Automatically verify invoices when they are created (if supplier is registered in eTIMS)

fields.label: Allow Payment Without Verification
fields.description: Allow payments for unverified invoices with approval (not recommended - may affect tax deductibility)

fields.label: Verification Amount Threshold
fields.description: Only verify invoices above this amount. Set to 0 to verify all invoices.

fields.label: Enable PO Tracking
fields.description: Track Purchase Orders for audit trail and invoice reconciliation

fields.label: Auto-Reconcile Invoices
fields.description: Automatically reconcile Purchase Invoices with original Purchase Orders

fields.label: Enable PO Notifications
fields.description: Send notifications when Purchase Orders are pending invoice for extended periods
